summary:
Tip: review records access and transfers this shift. Findings on workstation (ws-nurse-01), account jpark, session 74 (11:14-11:20Z):
1) Local log removal (F-e5d86b): the collector holds the jpark tty1 login at 11:14:18 (seq 29, ev_9b3995123e96) and logout (seq 30, ev_65f8e01c713e). The workstation auth.log keeps the logout (ev_0c41efcea0c4) but not the login. Rotation at 09:00 does not explain it. Confidence about 0.8.
2) Data staging (F-3accd5): shell history shows clinic-export --dataset patients_full writing /tmp/.font-unix/idx-3e08.bin at 11:15:15 (ev_3fb5abe9cac6). fs_stat shows a 20.6 MB file at 11:15:20 (ev_7f43d4470d7b). These are host-local records, not independently confirmed.
3) Policy-violating transfer (F-06531a): tap flow of 20,582,305 bytes to 10.20.9.87:8080 at 11:18:27-11:18:40 (ev_647a922ee132), matching curl -T of the staged file (ev_ad1c5aaad750). The destination is not an approved bulk destination.
Attribution: account jpark was used. The human operator is not established. Source 10.20.1.21 is bound to the workstation by timing and command match only. Remote VPN access is permitted and the 10.20.1.21 address is reachable remotely (ev_d9d49a92097c), and shared-station credentials have been found written down before. No person is named.
